plotEn: In 1984, Amyr Klink rows alone across the South Atlantic in a tiny boat, doing something no one had tried before. In 100 Days, his journey from Africa to Brazil becomes a fight against fear, loneliness, and the limits of his own strength. While his body struggles with the ocean, his mind wrestles with old memories, family issues, and the choices that shaped his life. In the end, crossing the ocean is only one part of the challenge, he also has to face and cross through himself.
